brief: Three bases arranged around an empty spot, with a bay tray standing in that spot.

requirements.requirement: Three bases arranged around an empty spot
requirements.evidence: Three full hex bases (piece) at axial cells (1,0), (1,-1) and (0,-1) on level 0. Each pair shares an edge, and all three border the empty cell (0,0). The original base at (0,0) was removed to leave that cell empty.

requirements.requirement: A bay tray standing in that spot
requirements.evidence: Bay notch hex-bin-bay-s-full-solid (full-depth solid bay tray, bay0) sits in the empty cell (0,0), beside the three bases. check_build reports meshClash 'clear' and no rule errors; the only info item is OPEN_CAP_FACE, which is advisory.

finish.summary: Built three full hex bases at (1,0), (1,-1), (0,-1) surrounding the empty cell (0,0), with a full-depth solid bay tray seated in that cell. The configurator's mesh check is clear and there are no rule errors. Open cap faces were reported as informational only and were not addressed, since the brief did not ask for them.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
